answer: Honest: 150 units locked 20 epochs; each honest epoch frees 5%. Forgery: the same 150 freeze on flagging; timer resets. Honest cost: 20 epochs of work. Forgery cost: dead capital. The tundra crossing takes 20 epochs. For 1,000 clones, honesty locks 150,000 units; forgery locks 150,000 earning nothing, 30% caught means 27,000 slashed. The voyage rewards the honest, bankrupts the forger; the crystal rule: time-locking punishes only the impatient.
